mapper.insert: insert into guest_consultation (session_id, turn_number, guest_id, question, answer, data_cards, create_time) values (#{sessionId}, #{turnNumber}, #{guestId}, #{question}, #{answer}, #{dataCards}, #{createTime})
mapper.select: select id, session_id as sessionId, question as title, answer as content, create_time as createTime from guest_consultation where turn_number = 1 and guest_id = #{guestId} order by create_time desc

select id, session_id as sessionId, turn_number as turnNumber, guest_id as userId, question, answer, data_cards as dataCardsJson, create_time as createTime from guest_consultation where session_id = #{sessionId} order by turn_number
